title: Why do we dream? - Amy Adkins
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】我們為什麼做夢？ - 艾米·阿德金斯（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In the third millenium BCE, Mesopotamian kings recorded and interpreted their dreams on wax tablets.
cues.en: In the third millenium BCE, Mesopotamian kings recorded and interpreted their dreams on wax tablets.
cues.zh: 公元前三千年 美索不達米亞諸王在蠟板上 記錄及解讀他們的夢

cues.text: A thousand years later, Ancient Egyptians wrote a dream book listing over a hundred common dreams and their meanings.
cues.en: A thousand years later, Ancient Egyptians wrote a dream book listing over a hundred common dreams and their meanings.
cues.zh: 一千多年之後 古埃及人寫了一本有關夢境的書 書中記載了一百多種 常見的夢境及其涵義 自那時候起

cues.text: And in the years since, we haven't paused in our quest to understand why we dream.
cues.en: And in the years since, we haven't paused in our quest to understand why we dream.
cues.zh: 書中記載了一百多種 常見的夢境及其涵義 自那時候起 我們從未停止探索 我們作夢的原因

cues.text: So, after a great deal of scientific research, technological advancement,
cues.en: So, after a great deal of scientific research, technological advancement,
cues.zh: 所以，儘管在大量的科學研究 科技的進步 以及堅持之下

cues.text: and persistence, we still don't have any definite answers, but we have some interesting theories.
cues.en: and persistence, we still don't have any definite answers, but we have some interesting theories.
cues.zh: 以及堅持之下 我們仍然沒有任何確切的答案 但我們發現了一些有趣的理論 我們在夢裡實現我們的願望

cues.text: We dream to fulfill our wishes.
cues.en: We dream to fulfill our wishes.
cues.zh: 我們仍然沒有任何確切的答案 但我們發現了一些有趣的理論 我們在夢裡實現我們的願望

cues.text: In the early 1900s, Sigmund Freud proposed that while all of our dreams, including our nightmares,
cues.en: In the early 1900s, Sigmund Freud proposed that while all of our dreams, including our nightmares,
cues.zh: 在 20 世紀初期 西格蒙德·佛洛伊德提出 我們所作的夢，包括噩夢 是從我們有意識的日常生活中 所整合的一套表像

cues.text: are a collection of images from our daily conscious lives, they also have symbolic meanings,
cues.en: are a collection of images from our daily conscious lives, they also have symbolic meanings,
cues.zh: 西格蒙德·佛洛伊德提出 我們所作的夢，包括噩夢 是從我們有意識的日常生活中 所整合的一套表像 這些夢也有一些象徵性的涵義

cues.text: which relate to the fulfillment of our subconscious wishes.
cues.en: which relate to the fulfillment of our subconscious wishes.
cues.zh: 這些夢也有一些象徵性的涵義 這些涵義與我們在潛意識中 想實現的願望有關

cues.text: Freud theorized that everything we remember when we wake up from a dream
cues.en: Freud theorized that everything we remember when we wake up from a dream
cues.zh: 這些涵義與我們在潛意識中 想實現的願望有關 佛洛伊德的理論認為 我們從夢中醒來還記得的事情

cues.text: is a symbolic representation of our unconscious primitive thoughts, urges, and desires.
cues.en: is a symbolic representation of our unconscious primitive thoughts, urges, and desires.
cues.zh: 佛洛伊德的理論認為 我們從夢中醒來還記得的事情 便是象徵我們在無意識下 原始想法、衝動、和慾望的表現

cues.text: Freud believed that by analyzing those remembered elements, the unconscious content would be revealed to our conscious mind,
cues.en: Freud believed that by analyzing those remembered elements, the unconscious content would be revealed to our conscious mind,
cues.zh: 佛洛伊德相信 藉由分析這些你所記得的元素 這些無意識的內容 得以在我們清醒的意識下揭露

cues.text: and psychological issues stemming from its repression could be addressed and resolved.
cues.en: and psychological issues stemming from its repression could be addressed and resolved.
cues.zh: 這些無意識的內容 得以在我們清醒的意識下揭露 而那些從無意識的壓抑 所衍生的心理問題 得以抒發和處理

cues.text: We dream to remember.
cues.en: We dream to remember.
cues.zh: 我們為了記憶而作夢

cues.text: To increase performance on certain mental tasks, sleep is good,
cues.en: To increase performance on certain mental tasks, sleep is good,
cues.zh: 要增強一些心智工作的效能 睡眠是很好的方法 但睡眠中作夢更好

cues.text: but dreaming while sleeping is better.
cues.en: but dreaming while sleeping is better.
cues.zh: 睡眠是很好的方法 但睡眠中作夢更好

cues.text: In 2010, researchers found that subjects were much better at getting through a complex 3-D maze
cues.en: In 2010, researchers found that subjects were much better at getting through a complex 3-D maze
cues.zh: 2010 年研究人員發現 實驗物件能夠更容易地 穿過複雜的 3D 立體迷宮 如果他們在第二次嘗試前 曾經小睡及夢到這個迷宮

cues.text: if they had napped and dreamed of the maze prior to their second attempt.
cues.en: if they had napped and dreamed of the maze prior to their second attempt.
cues.zh: 如果他們在第二次嘗試前 曾經小睡及夢到這個迷宮 實際上他們的表現能逹到十倍好

cues.text: In fact, they were up to ten times better at it than those who only thought of the maze while awake between attempts,
cues.en: In fact, they were up to ten times better at it than those who only thought of the maze while awake between attempts,
cues.zh: 實際上他們的表現能逹到十倍好 相較於那些僅在試驗間清醒時段 想過那迷宮的試驗者

cues.text: and those who napped but did not dream about the maze.
cues.en: and those who napped but did not dream about the maze.
cues.zh: 相較於那些僅在試驗間清醒時段 想過那迷宮的試驗者 以及小睡過 但未夢到迷宮的試驗者 研究人員認為 有些記憶處理過程

cues.text: Researchers theorize that certain memory processes can happen only when we are asleep,
cues.en: Researchers theorize that certain memory processes can happen only when we are asleep,
cues.zh: 研究人員認為 有些記憶處理過程 只能在我們睡著時才能發生

cues.text: and our dreams are a signal that these processes are taking place.
cues.en: and our dreams are a signal that these processes are taking place.
cues.zh: 只能在我們睡著時才能發生 而我們的夢 正是這些過程發生的訊號

cues.text: We dream to forget.
cues.en: We dream to forget.
cues.zh: 我們為了忘記而作夢

cues.text: There are about 10,000 trillion neural connections within the architecture of your brain.
cues.en: There are about 10,000 trillion neural connections within the architecture of your brain.
cues.zh: 大約有一千兆個神經連結 在你的大腦結構之中

cues.text: They are created by everything you think and everything you do.
cues.en: They are created by everything you think and everything you do.
cues.zh: 在你的大腦結構之中 它們從你所想所做的 全部事物中產生

cues.text: A 1983 neurobiological theory of dreaming, called reverse learning,
cues.en: A 1983 neurobiological theory of dreaming, called reverse learning,
cues.zh: 1983 年有個研究夢的 神經生物學理論，叫反向學習 說在睡眠時 並主要在快速動眼 期間

cues.text: holds that while sleeping, and mainly during REM sleep cycles,
cues.en: holds that while sleeping, and mainly during REM sleep cycles,
cues.zh: 說在睡眠時 並主要在快速動眼 期間

cues.text: your neocortex reviews these neural connections and dumps the unnecessary ones.
cues.en: your neocortex reviews these neural connections and dumps the unnecessary ones.
cues.zh: 你的大腦新皮質 會回顧這些神經連結 捨棄非必須的連結 如果沒有在夢境中排除記憶

cues.text: Without this unlearning process, which results in your dreams,
cues.en: Without this unlearning process, which results in your dreams,
cues.zh: 如果沒有在夢境中排除記憶

cues.text: your brain could be overrun by useless connections and parasitic thoughts could disrupt the necessary thinking
cues.en: your brain could be overrun by useless connections and parasitic thoughts could disrupt the necessary thinking
cues.zh: 你的腦子可能會充斥無用的連結 還有寄生的想法 可能幹擾你在清醒時必需做的思考

cues.text: you need to do while you're awake.
cues.en: you need to do while you're awake.
cues.zh: 可能幹擾你在清醒時必需做的思考

cues.text: We dream to keep our brains working.
cues.en: We dream to keep our brains working.
cues.zh: 可能幹擾你在清醒時必需做的思考 我們為了讓我們的腦子運作而作夢 「持續活化理論」提出 你的夢是來自

cues.text: The continual activation theory proposes that your dreams result from your brain's need to constantly consolidate and create long-term memories
cues.en: The continual activation theory proposes that your dreams result from your brain's need to constantly consolidate and create long-term memories
cues.zh: 「持續活化理論」提出 你的夢是來自 腦子需要不斷整合及產生 長期記憶而造成的

cues.text: in order to function properly.
cues.en: in order to function properly.
cues.zh: 腦子需要不斷整合及產生 長期記憶而造成的 如此才能正常運作

cues.text: So when external input falls below a certain level, like when you're asleep,
cues.en: So when external input falls below a certain level, like when you're asleep,
cues.zh: 如此才能正常運作 所以當外來的輸入 降到了某一個程度 譬如你睡著時

cues.text: your brain automatically triggers the generation of data from its memory storages,
cues.en: your brain automatically triggers the generation of data from its memory storages,
cues.zh: 譬如你睡著時 你的腦子自動地觸發 記憶儲存區產生資訊 而呈現給你的

cues.text: which appear to you in the form of the thoughts and feelings you experience in your dreams.
cues.en: which appear to you in the form of the thoughts and feelings you experience in your dreams.
cues.zh: 而呈現給你的 是在你夢裡經歷的想法和感覺 換句話說

cues.text: In other words, your dreams might be a random screen saver your brain turns on
cues.en: In other words, your dreams might be a random screen saver your brain turns on
cues.zh: 換句話說 你的夢可能是腦子開啟的 一個隨機螢幕保護程式 因而它不完全關閉

cues.text: so it doesn't completely shut down.
cues.en: so it doesn't completely shut down.
cues.zh: 因而它不完全關閉

cues.text: We dream to rehearse.
cues.en: We dream to rehearse.
cues.zh: 我們作夢來預演

cues.text: Dreams involving dangerous and threatening situations are very common,
cues.en: Dreams involving dangerous and threatening situations are very common,
cues.zh: 夢中包含危險及有威脅的情況 是很平常的 而「原始本能預演理論」認為

cues.text: and the primitive instinct rehearsal theory holds that the content of a dream is significant to its purpose.
cues.en: and the primitive instinct rehearsal theory holds that the content of a dream is significant to its purpose.
cues.zh: 夢中包含危險及有威脅的情況 是很平常的 而「原始本能預演理論」認為 夢的內容對於它的目的是很重要的 不論它是個在森林中 被熊追的焦慮夜晚

cues.text: Whether it's an anxiety-filled night of being chased through the woods by a bear
cues.en: Whether it's an anxiety-filled night of being chased through the woods by a bear
cues.zh: 不論它是個在森林中 被熊追的焦慮夜晚

cues.text: or fighting off a ninja in a dark alley, these dreams allow you to practice your fight or flight instincts
cues.en: or fighting off a ninja in a dark alley, these dreams allow you to practice your fight or flight instincts
cues.zh: 或是在黑暗的山谷中對抗一個忍者 這些夢讓你練習 你的打鬥或跳跑的直覺 並保持對這些技能的敏銳和信賴 以防你在現實生活中的需要

cues.text: and keep them sharp and dependable in case you'll need them in real life.
cues.en: and keep them sharp and dependable in case you'll need them in real life.
cues.zh: 並保持對這些技能的敏銳和信賴 以防你在現實生活中的需要

cues.text: But it doesn't always have to be unpleasant.
cues.en: But it doesn't always have to be unpleasant.
cues.zh: 但這並非全是不愉快的 譬如夢到那位嫵媚動人的鄰居

cues.text: For instance, dreams about your attractive neighbor could actually give your reproductive instinct some practice, too.
cues.en: For instance, dreams about your attractive neighbor could actually give your reproductive instinct some practice, too.
cues.zh: 譬如夢到那位嫵媚動人的鄰居 也可以實際給你的 生殖直覺一些練習

cues.text: We dream to heal.
cues.en: We dream to heal.
cues.zh: 我們作夢來療傷

cues.text: Stress neurotransmitters in the brain are much less active during the REM stage of sleep,
cues.en: Stress neurotransmitters in the brain are much less active during the REM stage of sleep,
cues.zh: 腦中的壓力神經傳導物質 在睡眠中的快速動眼期 比較不活躍 甚至在充滿創傷經驗的 夢中也是如此

cues.text: even during dreams of traumatic experiences, leading some researchers to theorize
cues.en: even during dreams of traumatic experiences, leading some researchers to theorize
cues.zh: 甚至在充滿創傷經驗的 夢中也是如此 這讓研究人員提出下列的理論 作夢的原因之一 是緩和痛苦的經驗

cues.text: that one purpose of dreaming is to take the edge off painful experiences
cues.en: that one purpose of dreaming is to take the edge off painful experiences
cues.zh: 這讓研究人員提出下列的理論 作夢的原因之一 是緩和痛苦的經驗

cues.text: to allow for psychological healing.
cues.en: to allow for psychological healing.
cues.zh: 作夢的原因之一 是緩和痛苦的經驗 來允許心理上的復原

cues.text: Reviewing traumatic events in your dreams with less mental stress may grant you a clearer perspective
cues.en: Reviewing traumatic events in your dreams with less mental stress may grant you a clearer perspective
cues.zh: 來允許心理上的復原 在夢中以較輕的心理壓力 來回顧受創事件 可以給你一個更清楚的視角

cues.text: and enhanced ability to process them in psychologically healthy ways.
cues.en: and enhanced ability to process them in psychologically healthy ways.
cues.zh: 和增強用心理健康的方法 處理這些事件的能力

cues.text: People with certain mood disorders and PTSD often have difficulty sleeping,
cues.en: People with certain mood disorders and PTSD often have difficulty sleeping,
cues.zh: 患有特定情緒失調 及創傷後壓力症候群 的人 常有睡眠上的困難 這讓一些科學家相信

cues.text: leading some scientists to believe that lack of dreaming may be a contributing factor to their illnesses.
cues.en: leading some scientists to believe that lack of dreaming may be a contributing factor to their illnesses.
cues.zh: 這讓一些科學家相信 缺少夢境可能是 他們得病的一個因素 我們作夢來解決問題

cues.text: We dream to solve problems.
cues.en: We dream to solve problems.
cues.zh: 我們作夢來解決問題

cues.text: Unconstrained by reality and the rules of conventional logic, in your dreams, your mind can create limitless scenarios
cues.en: Unconstrained by reality and the rules of conventional logic, in your dreams, your mind can create limitless scenarios
cues.zh: 不受限於現實和慣例邏輯的規則 在你的夢中 你的心智可以創造 無數的情境 來幫助你暸解問題

cues.text: to help you grasp problems and formulate solutions that you may not consider while awake.
cues.en: to help you grasp problems and formulate solutions that you may not consider while awake.
cues.zh: 無數的情境 來幫助你暸解問題 和制訂在你清醒時 無法考慮的解決辦法 約翰‧史坦貝克稱它為 「睡眠委員會」

cues.text: John Steinbeck called it the committee of sleep, and research has demonstrated
cues.en: John Steinbeck called it the committee of sleep, and research has demonstrated
cues.zh: 約翰‧史坦貝克稱它為 「睡眠委員會」 研究人員也展示了 夢在解決問題上的功效

cues.text: the effectiveness of dreaming on problem solving.
cues.en: the effectiveness of dreaming on problem solving.
cues.zh: 研究人員也展示了 夢在解決問題上的功效

cues.text: It's also how renowned chemist August Kekule discovered the structure of the benzene molecule,
cues.en: It's also how renowned chemist August Kekule discovered the structure of the benzene molecule,
cues.zh: 這也是著名的化學家 奧古斯汀‧凱庫勒 發現苯分子結構的途徑 而這個理由也是我們有時說 找到解決問題的最佳方法

cues.text: and it's the reason that sometimes the best solution for a problem is to sleep on it.
cues.en: and it's the reason that sometimes the best solution for a problem is to sleep on it.
cues.zh: 而這個理由也是我們有時說 找到解決問題的最佳方法 是睡覺想一想

cues.text: And those are just a few of the more prominent theories.
cues.en: And those are just a few of the more prominent theories.
cues.zh: 而這些只是一部份較著名的理論

cues.text: As technology increases our capability for understanding the brain,
cues.en: As technology increases our capability for understanding the brain,
cues.zh: 而這些只是一部份較著名的理論 隨著科技增進我們 瞭解腦子的能力

cues.text: it's possible that one day we will discover the definitive reason for them.
cues.en: it's possible that one day we will discover the definitive reason for them.
cues.zh: 有一天可能我們會發現 作夢的決定性理由 但是直到那一刻來臨 我們只能持續地作夢

cues.text: But until that time arrives, we'll just have to keep on dreaming.
cues.en: But until that time arrives, we'll just have to keep on dreaming.
cues.zh: 但是直到那一刻來臨 我們只能持續地作夢
